candidates.source_name: Work.ua — Finance & banking vacancy category (Фінанси, банк)

Category listing pages show a running vacancy count (search snippet indicated ~4,373 open finance/banking jobs), which makes vacancy-volume time series trivially derivable. Job titles reveal new role types (Head of Open Banking, еквайринг, ризик-менеджер) and city fields reveal hiring-location shifts (Kyiv vs Lviv vs remote/віддалено).

negative_findings.description: Direct Ukrainian- and English-language queries aimed at LinkedIn job pages for Ukraine banking leadership roles returned zero linkedin.com results; the engine returned Glassdoor mirrors instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: No LinkedIn job URLs surfaced via web search. This is consistent with LinkedIn job search being login-gated and largely de-indexed, not with the pages being absent. Recorded as unverified/hypothesis, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: LinkedIn is the primary channel for senior banking/payments roles and the only practical source for individual leadership moves in UA. If it cannot be reached by search or crawl, the 'leadership moves' topic in this cell must rely on manual analyst review or a licensed product, which changes cost and cadence assumptions.

negative_findings.description: No documented public/free vacancy API was found for work.ua, robota.ua, Djinni, DOU or Jooble during this pass. Jooble's site references partner/employer integrations and the state portal references API-based syndication, but no open developer documentation was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the state open-data route (data.gov.ua CKAN, form 3-ПН) is confirmed as a licence-clean machine-readable channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for the commercial boards will have to be HTML/DOM-based and therefore ToS-exposed and fragile. A licensing conversation (about.robota.ua, ua.jooble.org/info/contacts) may be a cheaper long-term path than scraping.

negative_findings.description: Searched for published time-series of banking/finance vacancy volume in Ukraine; found platform-level labour-market studies (robota.ua/budni, Work.ua articles, Djinni monthly analytics) but no banking-sector-specific vacancy index.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sector-specific vacancy-volume history does not appear to exist as a published product; it must be constructed from our own daily/weekly snapshots.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means the leading-indicator value of this cell only accrues after we start snapshotting — there is no backfill. Collection should start immediately even before analysis is designed.

negative_findings.description: Several local terms are noisy: 'банк' collides with 'банк даних'/'банк вакансій'; 'процесинг' appears in non-payment manufacturing contexts; 'еквайринг' is clean but low-volume; 'Jooble'/'Djinni' as query terms return the platforms' own hiring rather than banking vacancies (observed directly — the jooble query returned jobs AT Jooble).
negative_findings.result_summary: Naive keyword filters will produce substantial false positives and, for platform names, entirely off-target results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any vacancy-volume series must apply company-level and category-level filters, not keyword-only matching, or trend lines will be dominated by noise.

coverage_gaps.description: No systematic list of UA banks and licensed payment institutions mapped to their career-page URLs and their employer-profile slugs on DOU/Djinni/robota.ua was assembled in this pass; only a handful (PrivatBank, mono, OTP Bank UA, Accordbank, Alfa/Sense, Platon) were confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed a registry from the NBU register of banks and payment-market participants, then resolve each institution to (a) own career page, (b) DOU slug, (c) Djinni company id, (d) robota.ua employer page. This registry is the backbone of every per-employer hiring series.

coverage_gaps.description: Job boards show vacancies, not appointments. The 'leadership moves' topic is only weakly covered by this cell — LinkedIn (the natural source) is blocked, and boards rarely reveal who actually took a role.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with a separate appointment-tracking cell (NBU disclosures of management-body changes, bank press releases, Finclub/Mind/Forbes.ua personnel columns, executive-search firm announcements) rather than trying to extract appointments from vacancy data.

coverage_gaps.description: Hiring-location-shift analysis assumes comparable board coverage across oblasts; wartime displacement, relocated head offices and closed branches distort this, and small-town coverage sits mainly with aggregators (Jooble) whose data quality is lower.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Anchor geography analysis on the state 3-ПН open data (which has statutory oblast coverage) and use commercial boards only for relative movement; explicitly exclude/flag occupied and front-line oblasts.

coverage_gaps.description: Run languages were uk and en only. A meaningful share of legacy UA vacancy text (especially aggregator mirrors and older postings) is still Russian-language ('эквайринг', 'платёжные системы', 'руководитель департамента').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ru-language term variants to the glossary purely as a recall aid for matching UA-domain postings; do not treat as a separate language scope.

coverage_gaps.description: For every commercial board in this cell, robots.txt and ToS were not inspected in this pass, and no rate-limit or bot-defence posture was tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-domain compliance check (robots.txt, ToS scraping clause, observed anti-bot) before enabling any recurring collector; escalate Jooble and Glassdoor as likely bot-defended and LinkedIn as prohibited.

brief: Ukraine's vacancy landscape for banking/payments splits into four usable layers: two dominant general boards (work.ua, robota.ua) that carry the bulk of retail-banking and managerial postings with stable, keyword-parameterisable search URLs; two tech-talent platforms (Djinni, DOU.ua) that expose per-employer vacancy pages for banks and fintechs (mono/Fintech Band, PrivatBank, OTP Bank UA) and are the sharpest gauge of payments-platform and digital investment; aggregators (Jooble UA, TRUD.COM) plus curated niches (Happy Monday, banki.ua) that extend recall into small towns and long-tail employers; and a licence-clean state layer — the Єдиний портал вакансій and the State Employment Service's form 3-ПН datasets on data.gov.ua — which is the only bulk source free of ToS risk and the right anchor for regional analysis. The highest-value first-party sources are the NBU's own recruiting page (its payment-market supervision hires telegraph regulatory direction) and individual bank/PSP career pages, which must be assembled into an employer registry seeded from the NBU licence lists. Two structural constraints shape the cell: LinkedIn — the natural home of senior banking roles and the only real source for leadership moves — is login-walled and ToS-prohibited, and no published banking-sector vacancy time series exists, so the leading-indicator value only accrues from the moment snapshotting begins.
